note: Golden + edge vectors for the BNPL plan comparator (BNPL-COMPARATOR-NODE-1). Coverage: the three provider-labelled dollar examples (Klarna K2 service fee $248, Afterpay A1 finance fee $110, Affirm F1 monthly $400 and pay-in-4 $400) with their stated totals reproduced exactly, provider plan shapes applied to caller principals, custom equal-split plans with cent-remainder on the last instalment, a quoted interest-bearing plan, side-by-side comparisons with LOWEST_TOTAL_OF_PAYMENTS including a tie across all four providers, and eight named refusals (APR without quoted instalment, unknown preset, unknown cadence, preset-and-explicit, invalid principal, too many plans, invalid instalment count, empty plans). Every preset cites dated clauses from research/clause-snapshots/bnpl-{paypal,klarna,afterpay,affirm}-2026-10/SNAPSHOT.md; presets are labelled examples, never offers. golden_hash pinned (see vectors).
